gist.summary: Added @fedaasawalmeh753-cmyk’s Summering text to the writing app catalog and README’s recent-apps list. Its listing describes an Arabic, right-to-left static web app with client-side Pollinations OAuth 2.1 PKCE sign-in in a single index.html file; the catalog marks BYOP as false. Stickman Image Maker rotated out of the README’s recent-apps list, but was not removed from the catalog.

image.prompt: Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; small within the scene and wearing a tiny writer’s beret, she points to a right-to-left writing page on a retro computer beside a flowering code-plant. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream and lavender, and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
